title: Oat & Protein Powder Pancakes
description: Fluffy blended-oat pancakes with whey protein, served with nut butter and fresh fruit.
ingredients: Nut butter and berries to serve
steps: Blitz the oats, eggs, milk, baking powder, cinnamon and protein powder until smooth.
Fry small rounds in a little oil until bubbles appear, then flip and cook through.
Stack with nut butter and berries.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food easy protein pancakes

notes: These freeze well — reheat straight from frozen for a 90-second high-protein breakfast on busy mornings.
